changelog:
- Initial release of huawei-cloud-mrs-hive-sql-check skill.
- Provides automated Hive SQL syntax and specification checking using built-in checker engine.
- Supports triggers: “Hive SQL优化”, “检查Hive SQL”, “Hive SQL检查”, “Hive SQL规范”, “Hive SQL语法”, “Hive SQL review”.
- Enforces a strict reporting policy: only checker-detected rule violations are reported, with no extra manual analysis or interpretations.
- Supports syntax, specification, and interception checks across multi-statement SQL inputs according to Huawei Cloud MRS Hive standards.
summary: Huawei Cloud MRS Hive SQL specification checking skill. Checks SQL statements against defined syntax and specification rules using the automated checker engine. No extra manual analysis beyond defined rules. Trigger:"Hive SQL优化"、"检查Hive SQL"、"Hive SQL检查"、"Hive SQL规范"、"Hive SQL语法"、"Hive SQL review"
